headline: Export Scene Functionality Dependencies
what_breaks: packages/excalidraw/data/blob.ts — relies on export data types
packages/excalidraw/clipboard.ts — uses copy functions for clipboard operations
packages/excalidraw/element — depends on element manipulation functions
why: This file handles the export functionality for scenes, which is critical for user interaction. Changes here can affect how scenes are rendered and exported, impacting multiple components and utilities that rely on this functionality.
checklist: Review changes to functions like renderSceneToSvg and renderStaticScene
Check interactions with clipboard functions for exporting data
Ensure compatibility with element manipulation functions from @excalidraw/element
